methodologyNotes: Covers cabin-size rolling suitcases marketed and sold as carry-ons that fit the common US domestic 22 x 14 x 9 in overhead-bin envelope, sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes checked/large-check bags, underseat/personal-item bags, backpacks, and duffels. Price is typical US MSRP in USD at time of access. exteriorDimensionsIn is manufacturer-stated outer size including wheels and handles, formatted height x width x depth in inches. weightLbs is empty (unpacked) weight in pounds. capacityLiters is stated packing volume in liters (unexpanded); null if not published. shellType is an enum (hardside, softside, hybrid). shellMaterial is an enum of the primary shell material (polycarbonate, aluminum, polypropylene, abs, ballistic-nylon, recycled-poly). wheelType is an enum (spinner-4 for four dual/single spinner wheels, inline-2 for two fixed inline wheels). expandable is a boolean for a built-in expansion zipper. tsaLock is a boolean for an integrated TSA-approved combination lock. usbPort is a boolean for a built-in USB/power passthrough port. laptopSleeve is a boolean for a dedicated padded laptop compartment or sleeve. warranty is an enum of the manufacturer's coverage term (limited-lifetime, 10-year, 5-year, 3-year, 2-year, 1-year).

products.name: Travelpro Platinum Elite 21" Carry-On

The Amazon US listing for the same "Platinum Elite Softside Expandable Carry On... Carry On 21-Inch" model corroborated the 23.5"x14.5"x9" overall size, 7.8 lbs weight, softside high-density-nylon (DuraGuard) shell, external USB A&C ports, tapered 2" expansion, 8-wheel dual spinner, and Limited Lifetime warranty; its price showed in EUR for German delivery so it was not used for USD. Shell material was left null because "high-density nylon" does not match any allowed enum value; no integrated TSA lock is listed on either page and the base 21" size carries no dedicated laptop sleeve (a separate laptop-pocket/20" variant does), so those booleans are false.
